blurb: Stash 30.0 is the April 2021 release of Morgan Houppin's C UCI chess engine, following a major codebase consolidation. It adds aspiration windows, singular extensions, improving-scaled late move pruning, countermove and continuation histories, a pawn hash table, a KPK bitbase, and outpost evaluation. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper (Threads fixed to 1); Hash capped for 32-bit memory.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards (with optional BMI2 PEXT on native x86).

features.label: PVS & Aspiration Windows
features.implementation: Iterative deepening PVS with root aspiration windows and improving-flag heuristics.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Dynamic null-move pruning with zugzwang verification search.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Precomputed LMR table adjusted by improving status and quiet move history.

features.label: Late Move Pruning
features.implementation: Improving-scaled move-count pruning up to depth 5 alongside reverse futility pruning and razoring.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Excluded-move search from depth 9 extending singular transposition-table moves.

features.label: Continuation & Countermove History
features.implementation: Butterfly history paired with countermove heuristic, continuation histories, killers, and SEE.

features.label: Pawn Hash Table
features.implementation: Dedicated pawn-structure cache storing passed, isolated, doubled, and backward pawn terms.

features.label: KPK Bitbase
features.implementation: Exact precomputed king-and-pawn versus king win/draw bitbase.

features.label: King Safety
features.implementation: Weighted attacks on the enemy king zone with shelter and open-file rook pressure.

features.label: Outposts & Mobility
features.implementation: Minor-piece outposts, pawn-filtered mobility zones, space, and opposite-colored bishop scaling.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Packed middlegame/endgame score pairs with specialized KXK and endgame scaling.
